quotes.text: In D208830 the reviewer asked for view-flag tests; the author checked existing coverage and added four named tests to test_viewWrapper_virtualFolder.js. They spread reply threads across two folders and check unthreaded, threaded, grouped-by-sort, and persisted transitions after close/reopen. The tests check flag bits and row levels or dummy/container rows. Their own comment limits the first three to view-wrapper sanity checks, so they do not prove every backend ordering case. In this test file, name each add_task test_virtual_folder_threading_<case> and test the cross-folder data shape that exposed the bug.
